question: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are separated by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10° N parallel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** are separated by the **10° N parallel**, which divides the two groups of islands geographically.
 
• The **Andaman Islands** lie to the north of the 10° N parallel, while the **Nicobar Islands** are situated to the south of this line.
 
• The **10° N parallel** acts as a natural geographical marker between these two island groups, emphasizing their distinct environmental and socio-cultural characteristics.
 
• The separation also influences the flora, fauna, and climatic conditions between the two island groups, making each unique in its biodiversity.
 
• This division is significant in terms of administration, as the Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands are managed collectively as a union territory but maintain distinct identities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographical Features:**

 
 
• The **Andaman and Nicobar Islands** consist of over **500 islands**, of which only a few are inhabited.
 
• The islands are located in the **Bay of Bengal**, close to Southeast Asia, making them strategically important.
 
• They are known for their **pristine beaches, coral reefs**, and rich biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Climate and Biodiversity:**
 
 
• The islands experience a **tropical climate** with heavy rainfall during the monsoon season.
 
• Both the Andaman and Nicobar Islands host **endemic species** of plants and animals, including rare species like the **Andaman wild pig** and the **Nicobar pigeon**.
 
 
 
• **Cultural and Ethnic Diversity:**
 
 
• The islands are home to several **indigenous tribes**, including the **Great Andamanese**, **Onges**, **Sentinelese**, and **Shompens**.
 
• These tribes have distinct cultures, languages, and traditions, often living in isolation from the modern world.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• The islands are of strategic importance to India due to their location near international shipping lanes and proximity to Southeast Asia.
 
• India has established a strong military presence on the islands to safeguard its maritime interests.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **10° Channel:**

 
 
• The **10° Channel** is the water body that lies along the 10° N parallel and separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands.
 
• It is approximately **150 km wide** and plays a crucial role in shipping and navigation.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance:**
 
 
• The islands were historically used as a penal settlement by the British during colonial times, with the famous **Cellular Jail** located in Port Blair.
 
• The islands were also occupied by the Japanese during World War II, adding to their historical importance.
 
 
 
• **Tourism:**
 
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are a major tourist destination, attracting visitors with attractions like **Radhanagar Beach**, **Havelock Island**, and **Neil Island**.
 
• Activities such as **scuba diving**, **snorkeling**, and **trekking** are popular among tourists.
